9 Abilene {ab-ee-lay-nay'}

源自外來語, 參 SNG00058; 專有地名

欽定本 - Abilene 1; 1

亞比利尼 = "茂盛的草地"
1) 亞比拉城四周的地區,位於前黎巴嫩山脈南端,大馬色西北方,
   由分封王呂撒聶治理 (#路3:1|)
record.edic_text:
9 Abilene {ab-ee-lay-nay'}

of foreign origin, cf 58;; pr n loc

AV - Abilene 1; 1

Abilene = "grassy meadow"
1) a region of Syria between Lebanon and Hermon towards Phoenicia, 18
   miles (29 km) from Damascus and Heliopolis in a
   remarkable gorge called "Suk Wadi Barada".
